intro.text: A monastery given over to studying the Prophet's final words and working out what they mean.
A monastery devoted to studying the Prophet's final words, standing where the River Violet ends, close to the southern plains.

description.text: Its priests pore over the Prophet's words and argue about them: what it means to treat others badly, whether people choose to or are simply made that way, what happens to someone who forswears it and fails, and who decides. Its philosophers ask why Valor made people like that, and some of its writers held that those who control production behave worst, so everyone should share the burden.
Every priest carries a sword-staff, though none is taught to fight with it, and some belong to the Order of the Three Mandata.
Its large library holds many works on demonology and witchcraft.

items.text: In the second life December lived through, she made her way to the monastery and collapsed at its door, and Brother Grund carried her inside. She stayed almost ten years, studying demonology and witchcraft.

Once the plague started she set out for the plains. The monks heard her warnings but went on taking in refugees, healing them and sending them across the plains. They refused to abandon the monastery and died there.
